answer_summary: 2 of 41 gauge stations have authoritative geography (Chashma, Trimmu). Rainfall (PDMA), weather (PMD) and air quality (EPA Punjab) are associated with administrative units through the project's deterministic name resolver against the canonical model, which is explicitly qualified (not government-certified). Hazard alerts and disaster events are contextual.

relationships.evidence_source: Provincial Assembly of Sindh -- Sindh Act No. XIV of 2023 (The Institute of Mother and Child Health Act, 2023)
relationships.qualification: The Act (verified by reading the downloaded PDF text) names the district 'Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah)', i.e. one district under both names. The boundary dataset spells it 'Shaheed Benazir Abad' (a spacing variant of the Act's spelling); this spelling bridge is declared, not fuzzy. This is a name-equivalence statement, not a boundary certification; the canonical row 'Nawabshah' has no caveat. Status stays pending_manual_review like every crosswalk match.

relationships.boundary_name: Central / East / Korangi / Malir / South / West Karachi
relationships.qualification: The canonical model has a single 'Karachi' district; the boundary dataset has six Karachi districts. The relationship is one-to-many, so no single boundary unit may be assigned and none is chosen. Not applied.
Canonical units with no polygon in the 2022 boundary file (newer districts). Left unmatched; no polygon is borrowed from a parent district.

relationships.canonical_name: Fort Munro; Joharabad; Kamra; Mangla; Khanpur; Noorpur Thal; Rawalakot; Turbat
relationships.qualification: Towns, tehsils or reservoirs seeded as districts. A containment relationship (e.g. Turbat is in Kech, Rawalakot is in Poonch) is not an identity match and no official source for it was gathered, so nothing is mapped.

The 69-district canonical model does not contain these districts (e.g. Awaran, Bagh, Swabi, Haripur). Matching them would require extending geo.admin_unit, which is a canonical-model change outside Task 37 and a DB/PostGIS task.
